clips.title: The story
paras: In Moonbrook, union cards mark the laborers lost beneath the earth. Workers once carried them through the mines, and now the cards remain with skeletal dead in the dark drifts.

Before the Defias Brotherhood took control of Moonbrook, miners worked below ground for the guild, drawing valuable ore for the kingdom. A tunnel collapse crushed a major shaft and killed dozens beneath the rock. The dead rose as skeletal miners, excavators, and dynamiters. Union cards remain in their bony pockets, the last proof of who they were. In Stormwind, surviving colleagues seek the cards to learn the dead workers' identities and bring closure to their families.
